0022600090.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Indiana Pacers visit the New Orleans Pelicans, and Johnny Furphy is out for Indiana after knee surgery. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Pacers' most recent meeting was a 127-119 win in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pacers a 65% chance of winning.
